actors.name: CFO
actors.private_context: The CFO pushed back on the original Q4 marketing budget, leading to a revised proposal eight percent lower. They have weekly meetings with the CMO and a decent working relationship. They are aware the offsite agenda includes the campaign as a topic.

actors.name: CMO
actors.private_context: The CMO leads the marketing team and has revised the Q4 budget to eight percent below the original ask after the CFO's pushback. They have weekly meetings with the CFO and a decent working relationship. They know the offsite agenda lists the campaign as a topic.

shared_context: Ostara Foods has a leadership offsite scheduled for September 21, 2026. The offsite agenda already lists the campaign as a topic. The marketing team's revised Q4 budget is eight percent below the original ask. The CFO and CMO meet weekly and work together decently.

starting_events.description: The simulation begins. The revised Q4 budget exists but has not yet been submitted for approval.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the CFO actually approved the marketing team's revised Q4 budget before the leadership offsite on September 21, 2026 (i.e., before 2026-09-21T00:00:00+01:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the start of the offsite.
